faq.title: FAQ
faq.subtitle: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Find quick answers to the most common questions about our services and processes
faq.q1: How can I create an account?
faq.a1: To create an account, click on the "Register" button at the top of the page. Choose your account type (Candidate or Recruiter) and fill out the form with your information. You will receive a confirmation email to activate your account.
faq.a2: Our team is committed to responding to all requests within 24 to 48 business hours. For urgent questions, please do not hesitate to contact us by phone.
faq.q3: How to post a job offer?
faq.a3: After creating a recruiter account, log in to your space and click on "Post a job". Fill in the job details, define your criteria and publish. Your offer will be visible immediately after validation.
faq.a4: Registration and consultation of offers are completely free for candidates. For recruiters, we offer several packages adapted to your needs. Contact us for more details on our rates.
faq.q5: How to modify my profile information?
faq.a5: Log in to your account and access your personal space. Click on "My profile" then on "Edit". You can update your personal information, your CV, and your preferences at any time.
faq.q6: What to do if I forgot my password?
faq.a6: On the login page, click on "Forgot password?". Enter your email address and you will receive a link to reset your password. The link is valid for 24 hours.
faq.contactUs: Our team is here to help you. Feel free to contact us.
